english.note: Use this as the general choice when something is done silently or without being explicitly said.
Use this when someone does something silently without speaking, commenting, or drawing attention to their feelings.

examples.english: They tacitly helped me organize the documents without saying a word.
examples.traditional: 佢默默咁幫我執好啲文件，冇出聲。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 mak6 mak6 gam3 bong1 ngo5 zap1 hou2 di1 man4 gin6 mou5 ceot1 seng1

examples.english: I silently supported them for years and never said a word.
examples.traditional: 我默默咁支持佢多年，從來冇出聲。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mak6 mak6 gam3 zi1 ci4 keoi5 do1 nin4 cung4 loi4 mou5 ceot1 seng1
